nihata.p: [Ni+hana+ta(nihata-saṃ] (ti) CL=9 Ṇihaṇia-prā)](1) is killed- gotten rid of absolutely in order not to have any remnants.(2)(a) causes to reach the state of the absence of pride 'māna' that enjoys abnormally; is defeated/ is caused to lose. (b) is tortured; loses (c) fights- wins. (3) is killed, is murdered. (4) is put- caused to be. (5) is used always (as it exists permanently). (6) is appeased- calmed. (7) is killed- removed totally- so as not to have any remainder.
